text: Gardening, an activity that brings joy to many, offers numerous benefits, including improved soil health, enhanced beauty, and even a sense of well-being. One essential element for a thriving garden is mulch, which helps retain moisture and suppress weeds, while compost adds nutrients to the soil. Both are important for maintaining a healthy environment, but often overlooked. Mulch reduces soil erosion, prevents pests and diseases, and enriches the soil with organic matter, ensuring a bountiful harvest. Compost, on the other hand, boosts the overall health of the soil, making it more fertile and resilient, which benefits not only plants but also beneficial insects and microorganisms. By incorporating mulch and compost, gardeners can create a thriving, sustainable, and sustainable environment for their plants.
